title.zh: 卷十三 本紀第十三 憲宗一
title.raw: 卷十三 本紀第十三 憲宗一 Volume 13 Annals 13: Xianzong 1

sentences.zh: 憲宗繼天凝道誠明仁敬崇文肅武宏德聖孝純皇帝，諱見深，英宗長子也。

translations.literal: The Xianzong Emperor, Continuing Heaven, Concentrating the Way, Sincere, Bright, Benevolent, Reverent, Exalting Culture, Solemn in Martial Matters, Magnanimous in Virtue, Sagely Filial, and Pure, taboo name Jianshen, was the Yingzong Emperor's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzong—honored after death as one who continued Heaven, concentrated the Way, and united sincerity, brilliance, benevolence, reverence, literary exaltation, martial solemnity, magnanimous virtue, sagely filial devotion, and purity—was named Zhu Jianshen and was the eldest son of Emperor Yingzong.

sentences.zh: 母貴妃周氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Worthy Consort Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Worthy Consort Zhou.

sentences.zh: 初名見濬。

translations.literal: His original name was Jianjun.
translations.idiomatic: He was first named Zhu Jianjun.

sentences.zh: 英宗留瓦剌，皇太后命立為皇太子。

translations.literal: When the Yingzong Emperor was detained in Oirat, the Empress Dowager ordered him established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: While Yingzong was held captive among the Oirats, the Empress Dowager had Zhu Jianshen named crown prince.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年，廢為沂王。

translations.literal: In Jingtai year three he was deposed and made Prince of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jingtai he was stripped of the heirship and enfeoffed as Prince of Yi.

sentences.zh: 天順元年，復立為皇太子，改名見深。

translations.literal: In Tianshun year one he was again established Crown Prince and renamed Jianshen.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun one he was restored as crown prince and took the name Zhu Jianshen.

sentences.zh: 天順八年正月，英宗崩。

translations.literal: In the first month of Tianshun year eight the Yingzong Emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tianshun eight the Yingzong Emperor died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On the day yihai he assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zhu Jianshen ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 以明年為成化元年，大赦天下。

translations.literal: The coming year was made Chenghua year one; great pardon under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The following year was declared the first year of the Chenghua reign and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 免明年田租三之一。

translations.literal: One-third of the coming year's land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: One-third of the next year's land tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 浙江、江西、福建、陝西、臨清鎮守內外官，諸邊鎮守內官，正統間所無者悉罷之。

translations.literal: Garrison officials civil and military within and without in Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian, Shaanxi, and Linqing, and inner eunuchs on the frontier garrisons—every post unknown in the Zhengtong period—were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military garrison officers in Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian, Shaanxi, and Linqing, and palace eunuchs posted to the border—all offices created after Zhengtong that had not existed before—were abolished.

sentences.zh: 下番使者、緝事官校皆召還。

translations.literal: Envoys on maritime missions and intelligence agent officials were all recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Overseas mission envoys and secret-service agent-officials were all called home.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，始以內批授官。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengzi, offices were first granted by inner memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengzi, the court began appointing officials by imperial memo from within the palace.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅朔，尊皇后為慈懿皇太后，貴妃周氏為皇太后。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the new moon day jiayin, the Empress was honored Ciyi Empress Dowager and Worthy Consort Zhou was honored Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the third month, jiayin, the empress was elevated to Ciyi Empress Dowager and Worthy Consort Zhou was made empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 戊午，放宮人。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu palace women were sent out of the seraglio.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，毀錦衣新獄。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin the Brocade Guard's new prison was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Brocade Guard's new prison was torn down.

sentences.zh: 庚午，賜彭教等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Peng Jiao and others were granted jinshi with first, second, and third rank distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Peng Jiao and the other metropolitan graduates received their degrees with the usual three ranks.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔內閣九卿考覈天下方面官。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou an edict ordered the Grand Secretariat and the Nine Ministers to examine provincial officials throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the court commanded the Grand Secretariat and the Nine Ministers to review every regional commissioner in the empire.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，復立團營。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin the Corps encampment was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Corps encampment was restored.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未朔，日當食，不見。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the new moon day guiwei, the sun ought to have been eclipsed but was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon of guiwei, an eclipse was due but never appeared.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，大風雨雹，敕臣修省。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingsi, great wind, rain, and hail; an edict ordered the ministers to practice austerity and self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingsi, violent wind, rain, and hail fell; the Emperor ordered his ministers to repent and reform their conduct.

sentences.zh: 庚申，葬睿皇帝於裕陵。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen the Rui Emperor was buried at Yuling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the late Yingzong—temple name Rui—was interred at Yuling.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，立吳氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day renshen, the Wu clan was established Empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renshen, Lady Wu was made empress.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，御經筵。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guiwei, he attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guiwei, the Emperor took his seat at the imperial lecture on the classics.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命儒臣日講。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Confucian officials were ordered to lecture daily.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Confucian scholars were commanded to give daily lectures at court.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，廢皇后吳氏。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Empress Wu was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Empress Wu was stripped of her title.

sentences.zh: 下太監牛玉於獄。

translations.literal: Eunuch Niu Yu was sent to prison.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Niu Yu was thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰，立王氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day renchen, the Wang clan was established Empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renchen, Lady Wang was made empress.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，立武舉法。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen the military examination system was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the military examination law was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，免京官雜犯罪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiachen, miscellaneous crimes of capital officials were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiachen, petty offenses of Beijing officials were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 是年，兩畿、川、廣、荊、襄盜賊大起，道路不通。

translations.literal: That year bandits rose on a great scale in the two capitals circuits, Sichuan, Guang, Jing, and Xiang; roads were impassable.
translations.idiomatic: That year brigands swarmed the metropolitan districts, Sichuan, Guangdong, Huguang, and the Han River basin until travel broke down.

sentences.zh: 安南、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: Annam and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Annam and U-Tsang presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 成化元年

translations.literal: Chenghua year one.
translations.idiomatic: The first year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 成化元年春正月乙卯，享太廟。

translations.literal: In spring of Chenghua year one, first month, on the day yimao, the Imperial Ancestors were sacrificed to at the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in Chenghua one, on yimao, the Emperor offered at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 己未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he performed the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 甲子，都督同知趙輔為征夷將軍，充總兵官，僉都御史韓雍贊理軍務，討廣西叛瑤。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi Regional Commander Zhao Fu was made General for the Punitive Campaign against the Yi and supreme commander; Vice Censor-in-chief Han Yong supervised military affairs, to suppress the rebellious Yao of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Zhao Fu, regional commander, was made general for the punitive campaign against the Yi and supreme commander, with Han Yong, vice censor-in-chief, as military superintendent, to crush the rebel Yao in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，祭社稷。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day wuzi, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuzi, the Emperor sacrificed to the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 甲午，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he performed the ceremonial plowing of the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，四川山都掌蠻亂。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengxu, the Shanduzhang Man of Sichuan rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengxu, the Shanduzhang tribes of Sichuan rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，釋奠於先師孔子。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi the sacrifice of release was offered to the Master Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the court offered the seasonal sacrifice to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 夏五月辛酉，大雨雹。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, on the day xinyou, great rain and hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on xinyou, heavy rain and hail fell.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，避正殿減，敕臣修省。

translations.literal: On the day renxu he withdrew from the main hall, reduced meals, and ordered the ministers to practice austerity and self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Emperor left the main hall, cut his table, and commanded the ministers to repent and reform their conduct.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，免天下軍屯糧十之三。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day jiyou, one-third of garrison grain throughout the realm was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiyou, one-third of military colony grain tax empire-wide was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲子，振兩畿、浙江、河南饑。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi famine in the two capitals circuits, Zhejiang, and Henan was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi relief was sent to famine in the metropolitan districts, Zhejiang, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，工部侍郎沈義、僉都御史吳琛振撫兩畿饑民。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day dingchou, Vice Minister of Works Shen Yi and Vice Censor-in-chief Wu Chen relieved and pacified famine victims in the two capitals circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingchou, Shen Yi, vice minister of works, and Wu Chen, vice censor-in-chief, were dispatched to feed and settle famine refugees in the metropolitan districts.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，瘞暴骸。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi exposed corpses were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi unburied dead were interred.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，毛里孩犯延綏，總兵官房能敗之。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin Molihai raided Yan-sui; Regional Commander Fang Neng defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Molihai struck Yan-sui; Fang Neng, regional commander, beat him back.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月癸卯，撫寧伯朱永為靖虜將軍，充總兵官，太監唐慎監軍，工部尚書白圭提督軍務，討荊、襄賊。

translations.literal: In winter, twelfth month, on the day guimao, Pacification Baron Zhu Yong was made General for the Pacification Campaign against the Barbarians and supreme commander; Eunuch Tang Shen supervised the army; Minister of Works Bai Gui directed military affairs, to suppress bandits in Jing and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on guimao, Zhu Yong, Pacification Baron, was made general for the pacification of the barbarians and supreme commander; the eunuch Tang Shen oversaw the army; Bai Gui, minister of works, directed operations against the Jing-Xiang rebels.

sentences.zh: 是月，韓雍大破大藤峽瑤，改名峽曰「斷藤」。

translations.literal: That month Han Yong greatly defeated the Yao of Great Vine Gorge; the gorge was renamed "Broken Vine."
translations.idiomatic: That month Han Yong shattered the Yao at Great Vine Gorge, which was then renamed Broken Vine.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、哈密、爪哇、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu, Hami, Java, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu, Hami, Java, and U-Tsang presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 成化二年

translations.literal: Chenghua year two.
translations.idiomatic: The second year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月戊申，罷團營。

translations.literal: In spring of the second year, first month, on the day wushen, the Corps encampment was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in Chenghua two, on wushen, the Corps encampment was disbanded.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day yimao the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，英宗神主祔太廟。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou the Yingzong Emperor's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Yingzong's spirit tablet was placed in the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，禮部侍郎鄒幹巡視畿內饑民。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day guiwei, Vice Minister of Rites Zou Gan was sent to inspect famine victims within the metropolitan districts.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiwei, Zou Gan, vice minister of rites, was sent to survey famine in the capital region.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，賜羅倫等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiachen, Luo Lun and others were granted jinshi with first, second, and third rank distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiachen, Luo Lun and the other graduates received their metropolitan degrees with the usual three ranks.

sentences.zh: 己酉，李賢父卒，乞終制，不許。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou Li Xian's father died; he begged to observe mourning to the end but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Li Xian's father died; he asked leave for full mourning but the court refused.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，朱永大破荊、襄賊劉通於南漳。

translations.literal: On the day yimao Zhu Yong greatly defeated the Jing-Xiang bandit Liu Tong at Nanzhang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zhu Yong routed the Jing-Xiang rebel Liu Tong at Nanzhang.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸酉，振南畿饑。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day guiyou, famine in the Southern Capital circuit was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on guiyou, relief was sent to famine around Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 乙未，朱永擊擒劉通，其黨石龍遁，轉掠四川。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei Zhu Yong attacked and captured Liu Tong; his partisan Shi Long fled and turned to plunder Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Zhu Yong seized Liu Tong; the remnant leader Shi Long escaped and ravaged Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸酉，修撰羅倫以論李賢起復謫福建市舶司提舉。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, on the day guiyou, Compiler Luo Lun, for memorializing on Li Xian's recall from mourning, was demoted to Superintendent of the Fujian Maritime Trade Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on guiyou, Luo Lun, compiler, was banished to superintendent of the Fujian maritime trade office for criticizing Li Xian's forced return from mourning.

sentences.zh: 己卯，禁侵損古帝王、忠臣、烈士、名賢陵墓。

translations.literal: On the day jimao encroachment on and damage to the tombs of ancient emperors, loyal ministers, martyrs, and famed worthies were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the court forbade anyone to encroach on or defile the graves of ancient sovereigns, loyal ministers, martyrs, and celebrated sages.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，趙輔師還。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiachen, Zhao Fu's army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiachen, Zhao Fu's expedition came home.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，免今年天下屯糧十之三。

translations.literal: On the day yisi one-third of this year's garrison grain throughout the realm was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi one-third of the year's military colony grain tax was forgiven empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 壬子，楊信為平虜將軍，充總兵官，太監裴當監督軍務，禦寇延綏。

translations.literal: On the day renzi Yang Xin was made General for the Pacification Campaign against the Raiders and supreme commander; Eunuch Pei Dang supervised military affairs, to repel the enemy at Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yang Xin was made general for the pacification of raiders and supreme commander; the eunuch Pei Dang oversaw the campaign on the Yan-sui front.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，封弟見治為忻王，見沛徽王。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day xinsi, the younger brother Jianzhi was enfeoffed Prince of Xin and Jianpei Prince of Hui.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinsi, his younger brothers Zhu Jianzhi and Zhu Jianpei were enfeoffed as princes of Xin and Hui.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，毛里孩犯固原。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu Molihai raided Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Molihai struck Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，犯寧夏，都指揮焦政戰死。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day dingsi, he raided Ningxia; Regional Commander Jiao Zheng died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingsi, he attacked Ningxia; Jiao Zheng, regional commander, was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，諭祭于謙，復其子冕官。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao an edict ordered sacrifice to Yu Qian; his son Mian's office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the court commanded rites for Yu Qian and reinstated his son Mian in office.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，朱永擊擒石龍，賊平，進永爵為侯。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day dingwei, Zhu Yong attacked and captured Shi Long; the bandits were pacified; Yong's enfeoffment was advanced to marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingwei, Zhu Yong seized Shi Long, the rebellion ended, and Yong was raised from baron to marquis.

sentences.zh: [一]十二月甲寅，李賢卒。

translations.literal: [1] In the twelfth month, on the day jiayin, Li Xian died.
translations.idiomatic: [1] In the twelfth month, on jiayin, Li Xian died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，太常寺少卿兼翰林院侍讀學士劉定之入閣預機務。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Concurrent Hanlin Attendant Reader Liu Dingzhi entered the Grand Secretariat to participate in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Liu Dingzhi, vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Hanlin attendant reader, joined the Grand Secretariat to deliberate state secrets.

sentences.zh: 是月，斷藤峽賊復起。

translations.literal: That month the bandits of Broken Vine Gorge rose again.
translations.idiomatic: That month the rebels at Broken Vine Gorge took up arms again.

sentences.zh: 是年，哈密、琉球、安南、烏斯藏、瓦剌入貢。

translations.literal: That year Hami, Ryukyu, Annam, U-Tsang, and Oirat sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hami, Ryukyu, Annam, U-Tsang, and the Oirats presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 成化三年

translations.literal: Chenghua year three.
translations.idiomatic: The third year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring of the third year, first month, on the day jimao, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in Chenghua three, on jimao, the Emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 丙申，撫寧侯朱永為平胡將軍，充總兵官，會楊信討毛里孩。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen Pacification Marquis Zhu Yong was made General for the Pacification Campaign against the Hu and supreme commander; he joined Yang Xin to campaign against Molihai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zhu Yong, Pacification Marquis, was made general for the pacification of the Hu and supreme commander and marched with Yang Xin against Molihai.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the new moon day dingyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the second month, dingyou, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，湖廣總兵官李震討破靖州苗。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi Regional Commander Li Zhen of Huguang attacked and defeated the Miao of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Zhen, Huguang regional commander, crushed the Jingzhou Miao.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，召商輅為兵部侍郎，復入閣。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuchen, Shang Lu was summoned as Vice Minister of War and again entered the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuchen, Shang Lu was recalled as vice minister of war and rejoined the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己巳，毛里孩犯大同。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Molihai raided Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Molihai struck Datong.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，復開浙江、福建、四川、雲南銀場，以內臣領之。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi silver mines in Zhejiang, Fujian, Sichuan, and Yunnan were reopened, led by inner eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the court reopened silver mines in Zhejiang, Fujian, Sichuan, and Yunnan under palace eunuch superintendents.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，四川地屢震，自去年六月至於是月。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, Sichuan's earth quaked repeatedly, from the sixth month of the previous year until this month.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Sichuan suffered repeated earthquakes, beginning in the sixth month of the year before and continuing through this month.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，錄囚。

translations.literal: On the day yisi prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the court held its prison review.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，復立團營。

translations.literal: On the day guichou the Corps encampment was again established.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the Corps encampment was restored once more.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，雷震南京午門，敕臣修省。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wushen, lightning struck Nanjing's Meridian Gate; an edict ordered the ministers to practice austerity and self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wushen, lightning struck the Meridian Gate at Nanjing; the Emperor ordered his ministers to repent and reform their conduct.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，襄城伯李瑾為征夷將軍，充總兵官，兵部尚書程信提督軍務，太監劉恆監軍，討山都掌蠻。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou Xiangcheng Earl Li Jin was made General for the Punitive Campaign against the Yi and supreme commander; Minister of War Cheng Xin directed military affairs; Eunuch Liu Heng supervised the army, to campaign against the Shanduzhang Man.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Li Jin, Xiangcheng Earl, was made general for the punitive campaign against the Yi and supreme commander; Cheng Xin, minister of war, directed operations; the eunuch Liu Heng oversaw the army against the Shanduzhang tribes.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，停河南採辦。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day yiyou, Henan procurement levies were halted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yiyou, special requisitions in Henan were stopped.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，振湖廣、江西饑。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinwei, famine in Huguang and Jiangxi was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinwei, relief was sent to famine in Huguang and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月庚子，左庶子黎淳追論景泰廢立事，帝曰：「景泰事已往，朕不介意，且非臣下所當言。

translations.literal: In winter, twelfth month, on the day gengzi, Left Associate of the Heir Apparent Li Chun pursued discussion of the Jingtai deposition and enthronement affair; the Emperor said: "The Jingtai affair is past; I do not mind, and moreover it is not what subjects ought to speak of."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on gengzi, Li Chun, left associate of the heir apparent, revived debate over Jingtai's removal and enthronement; the Emperor said, "The Jingtai matter is over; I bear no grudge, and in any case subjects should not raise it."

sentences.zh: 」切責之。

translations.literal: He rebuked him sharply.
translations.idiomatic: He censured Li Chun in the strongest terms.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，杖編修章懋、黃仲昭，檢討莊昹，謫官有差。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Compiler Zhang Mao and Huang Zhongzhao and Proofreader Zhuang Ang were beaten with the stick and demoted with varying penalties.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the compilers Zhang Mao and Huang Zhongzhao and proofreader Zhuang Ang were flogged and demoted to various posts.

sentences.zh: 是月，程信破山都掌蠻，平之。

translations.literal: That month Cheng Xin defeated the Shanduzhang Man and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: That month Cheng Xin broke the Shanduzhang tribes and brought them to submission.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、哈密、占城、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu, Hami, Champa, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu, Hami, Champa, and U-Tsang presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮獻海青、白鵲，諭毋獻。

translations.literal: Korea presented sea eagles and white magpies; they were instructed not to present them again.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent sea eagles and white magpies; the court told them to bring no more such gifts.

sentences.zh: 成化四年

translations.literal: Chenghua year four.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月甲戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourth year, first month, on the day jiaxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in Chenghua four, on jiaxu, the Emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，免湖廣被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiazi, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiazi, autumn tax grain was forgiven in disaster-hit Huguang.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔中外勢家毋得擅請田土。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen an edict: powerful families within and without the court must not privately petition for fields and land.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen an edict forbade influential households at court and in the provinces from seeking land grants on their own authority.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，錄囚。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day dingsi, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi, the court held its prison review.

sentences.zh: 陳文卒。

translations.literal: Chen Wen died.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Wen died.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，遣使錄天下囚。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day guiwei, envoys were dispatched to review prisoners throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiwei, envoys were sent to review prisoners empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，免江西被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingwu, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Jiangxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingwu, autumn grain tax was forgiven in disaster-hit Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，開城賊滿俊反，陝西總兵官寧遠伯任壽、巡撫都御史陳价討之。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the Kaicheng bandit Man Jun rebelled; Ren Shou, Baron of Ningyuan and supreme commander on Shaanxi, and Chen Jia, supreme censor and regional commander, campaigned against him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the Kaicheng rebel Man Jun rose; Ren Shou, Baron of Ningyuan and Shaanxi supreme commander, and Chen Jia, regional commander and supreme censor, marched against him.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，慈懿皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the Empress Dowager Ciyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the Empress Dowager Ciyi died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，都督同知劉玉為平虜副將軍，充總兵官，太監劉祥監軍，副都御史項忠總督軍務，討滿俊。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day guiyou, Liu Yu, vice commissioner-in-chief, was made Deputy General for the Pacification of the Barbarians and served as supreme commander; the eunuch Liu Xiang supervised the army; Xiang Zhong, vice censor-in-chief, was overall director of military affairs, to campaign against Man Jun.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiyou, Liu Yu, vice commissioner-in-chief, was made deputy pacification general and supreme commander, with the eunuch Liu Xiang as army supervisor; Xiang Zhong, vice censor-in-chief, took overall command to suppress Man Jun.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guisi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guisi, an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，朱永代劉玉為總兵官。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Zhu Yong replaced Liu Yu as supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zhu Yong replaced Liu Yu as supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 是月，任壽、陳价、寧夏總兵官廣義伯吳琮及滿俊戰，敗績，都指揮蔣泰、申澄被殺。

translations.literal: That month, Ren Shou, Chen Jia, Wu Cong, Baron of Guangyi and supreme commander in Ningxia, and Man Jun fought; the government army was defeated, and regional commanders Jiang Tai and Shen Cheng were killed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ren Shou, Chen Jia, Wu Cong, Baron of Guangyi and Ningxia supreme commander, fought Man Jun and were beaten; regional commanders Jiang Tai and Shen Cheng fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，葬孝莊睿皇后於裕陵。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day gengshen, Empress Xiaozhuang Rui was buried at Yuling.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengshen, Empress Xiaozhuang Rui was interred at Yuling.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，振陝西饑。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, relief was extended for famine in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court sent famine relief to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以地震、星變下詔自責，敕臣修省。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, because of the earthquake and irregular stars, an edict of self-reproach was issued and officials were ordered to practice self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, citing the earthquake and celestial omens, the Emperor issued a self-reproach edict and ordered officials to examine their conduct.

sentences.zh: 甲申，給事中董旻、御史胡深等九人請罷商輅及禮部尚書姚夔，下獄，杖之。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the supervising secretary Dong Min, the investigating censor Hu Shen, and eight others requested the dismissal of Shang Lu and Minister of Rites Yao Kui; they were imprisoned and beaten with the stick.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Dong Min, Hu Shen, and eight other remonstrance officials called for the dismissal of Shang Lu and Minister of Rites Yao Kui; they were jailed and flogged.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，項忠敗賊於石城，伏羌伯毛忠戰死。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day yiwei, Xiang Zhong defeated the bandits at Shicheng; Mao Zhong, Baron of Fuxiang, died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yiwei, Xiang Zhong routed the rebels at Shicheng; Mao Zhong, Baron of Fuxiang, was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 十一月，項忠擊擒滿俊，送京師，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Xiang Zhong attacked and captured Man Jun, sent him to the capital, and he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Xiang Zhong seized Man Jun, sent him to the capital, and had him executed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，毛里孩犯遼東，指揮胡珍戰沒。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Maolihai invaded Liaodong; Commander Hu Zhen died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Maolihai struck Liaodong; Commander Hu Zhen was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，遼東總兵官趙勝奏：「十一月初六日，虜賊千餘攻指揮傅斌營，指揮胡珍率軍來援，被賊射死。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiyou, Zhao Sheng, supreme commander in Liaodong, memorialized: "On the sixth day of the eleventh month, over a thousand bandits attacked Commander Fu Bin's camp; Commander Hu Zhen led troops to the rescue and was shot dead by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiyou, Zhao Sheng, Liaodong supreme commander, reported: "On the sixth of the eleventh month more than a thousand raiders struck Commander Fu Bin's camp; Commander Hu Zhen came to relieve him and was shot dead by the enemy."

sentences.zh: 」毛里孩犯延綏，都指揮僉事許寧擊敗之。

translations.literal: Maolihai invaded Yan-sui; Vice Regional Commander Xu Ning defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Maolihai then invaded Yan-sui; Vice Regional Commander Xu Ning beat him back.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、烏斯藏、哈密、日本、滿剌加入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, U-Tsang, Hami, Japan, and Malacca sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from Ryukyu, U-Tsang, Hami, Japan, and Malacca.

sentences.zh: 成化五年

translations.literal: Chenghua year five.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙丑，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the day yichou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the first month of spring, on yichou, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，賜張昇等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day xinchou, Zhang Sheng and others were granted jinshi with distinctions of rank and origin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinchou, Zhang Sheng and others received jinshi degrees with distinctions of rank and origin.

sentences.zh: 夏五月辛丑，禮部侍郎萬安兼翰林院學士，入閣預機務。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, on the day xinchou, Wan An, Vice Minister of Rites, also held the post of Hanlin academician and entered the Grand Secretariat to participate in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on xinchou, Wan An, vice minister of rites, was also made Hanlin academician and entered the Grand Secretariat to help govern.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the new moon day guichou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon guichou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，錄囚。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛酉，劉定之卒。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, on the day xinyou, Liu Dingzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on xinyou, Liu Dingzhi died.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙未，毛里孩犯延綏。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on the day yiwei, Maolihai invaded Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on yiwei, Maolihai invaded Yan-sui.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，阿羅出入居河套。

translations.literal: That winter, Aluochu moved in and out of the Ordos bend.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Aluochu began raiding in and out of the Ordos bend.

sentences.zh: 琉球、哈密、烏斯藏、滿剌加、安南、土魯番入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu, Hami, U-Tsang, Malacca, Annam, and Turfan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Embassies came from Ryukyu, Hami, U-Tsang, Malacca, Annam, and Turfan.

sentences.zh: 成化六年

translations.literal: Chenghua year six.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月己丑，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on the day jichou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, in the first month of spring, on jichou, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 己亥，大同總兵官楊信敗毛里孩於胡柴溝。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Yang Xin, supreme commander at Datong, defeated Maolihai at Huchai Gully.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Yang Xin, Datong supreme commander, routed Maolihai at Huchai Gully.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，大理寺少卿宋旻，侍郎曾翬、原傑、黃琛，副都御史滕昭巡視畿南、浙江、河南、四川、福建，考察官吏，訪軍民疾苦。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinwei, Song Min, Vice President of the Court of Judicial Review, and Vice Ministers Zeng Hui, Yuan Jie, Huang Chen, and Vice Censor-in-chief Teng Zhao toured the metropolitan south, Zhejiang, Henan, Sichuan, and Fujian to inspect officials and inquire into the hardships of soldiers and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinwei, Song Min of the Court of Judicial Review and vice ministers Zeng Hui, Yuan Jie, Huang Chen, with Vice Censor-in-chief Teng Zhao, toured the metropolitan south, Zhejiang, Henan, Sichuan, and Fujian to inspect officials and hear soldiers' and civilians' grievances.

sentences.zh: 其餘直省有巡撫等官者，命亦如之。

translations.literal: In the other directly administered provinces where grand coordinators and the like already existed, orders were likewise issued.
translations.idiomatic: In other directly administered provinces that already had grand coordinators, similar orders were issued.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，禱雨於郊壇。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, rain was prayed for at the suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the court prayed for rain at the suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，振廣西饑。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, relief was extended for famine in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin famine relief was sent to Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，免湖廣、山東被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiashen, tax grain in disaster-stricken Huguang and Shandong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiashen, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-hit Huguang and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔延綏屯田。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, an edict ordered garrison farming in Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict ordered military colonies established on the Yan-sui front.

sentences.zh: 朱永為平虜將軍，充總兵官，太監傅恭、顧恆監軍，王越參贊軍務，備阿羅出於延綏。

translations.literal: Zhu Yong was made General for the Pacification of the Barbarians and served as supreme commander; the eunuchs Fu Gong and Gu Heng supervised the army; Wang Yue assisted in military affairs, to guard against Aluochu on the Yan-sui front.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yong was made pacification general and supreme commander, with eunuchs Fu Gong and Gu Heng as army supervisors; Wang Yue assisted in command to block Aluochu on the Yan-sui front.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙申，振畿內、山東、河南饑。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, on the day bingshen, relief was extended for famine in the metropolitan districts, Shandong, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on bingshen, famine relief was sent to the capital region, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，王越敗阿羅出於延綏東路。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Wang Yue defeated Aluochu on the eastern route in Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Wang Yue defeated Aluochu on the eastern Yan-sui route.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the new moon day wushen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon wushen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，朱永敗阿羅出於雙山堡。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day renwu, Zhu Yong defeated Aluochu at Shuangshan Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu, Zhu Yong beat Aluochu at Shuangshan Fort.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，都御史項忠、侍郎葉盛振畿輔饑民。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Supreme Censor Xiang Zhong and Vice Minister Ye Sheng relieved famine victims in the metropolitan region.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Xiang Zhong, supreme censor, and Vice Minister Ye Sheng distributed relief to famine victims around the capital.

sentences.zh: 都督李昹撫治屯營。

translations.literal: Commissioner-in-chief Li Ang oversaw garrison farms.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner-in-chief Li Ang took charge of garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，總兵官房能敗阿羅出於開荒川。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Supreme Commander Fang Neng defeated Aluochu at Kaihuang River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Supreme Commander Fang Neng routed Aluochu at Kaihuang River.

sentences.zh: 是月，免南畿、四川被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That month, tax grain in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region and Sichuan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month tax grain was forgiven in disaster districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，振山西饑。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinhai, relief was extended for famine in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinhai, famine relief was sent to Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以水旱相仍，下詔寬卹。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, because flood and drought followed one upon another, an edict granted lenient relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, with flood and drought in succession, an edict ordered broad tax relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，免畿內、河南、山東被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, tax grain in disaster-stricken districts of the metropolitan region, Henan, and Shandong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, tax grain was forgiven in disaster districts of the capital region, Henan, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，荊、襄流民作亂，項忠總督河南、湖廣、荊、襄軍務討之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day guimao, displaced persons from Jing and Xiang rose in revolt; Xiang Zhong was overall director of military affairs in Henan, Huguang, Jing, and Xiang to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guimao, refugees from Jing and Xiang rebelled; Xiang Zhong took overall command in Henan, Huguang, Jing, and Xiang to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 是月，孛羅忽渡河與阿羅出合。

translations.literal: That month, Boluohu crossed the river and joined Aluochu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Boluohu crossed the Yellow River and joined Aluochu.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，遣使十四人分振畿輔。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengxu, fourteen envoys were dispatched in separate missions to relieve famine in the metropolitan region.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengxu, fourteen envoys were sent out separately to relieve famine around the capital.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、哈密、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Hami, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from Ryukyu, Hami, and U-Tsang.

sentences.zh: 成化七年

translations.literal: Chenghua year seven.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月辛巳，命京官五品以上及給事中、御史各舉堪州縣者一人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on the day xinsi, capital officials of the fifth rank and above, together with supervising secretaries and censors, were each ordered to recommend one man fit for prefectural and county posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, in the first month of spring, on xinsi, every capital official of fifth rank or above, with supervising secretaries and censors, was ordered to nominate one man fit for local office.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳，錄囚。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day jisi, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jisi, the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，瘞京師暴骸。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day xinsi, exposed corpses in the capital were buried.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinsi, unburied dead in the capital were interred.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲辰，振山東、浙江水災。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, on the day jiachen, relief was extended for flood disaster in Shandong and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on jiachen, flood relief was sent to Shandong and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 閏九月己未，浙江潮溢，漂民居、鹽場，遣工部侍郎李顒往祭海神，修築堤岸。

translations.literal: In the intercalary ninth month, on the day jiwei, the tide in Zhejiang overflowed and swept away dwellings and salt fields; Vice Minister of Works Li Yong was sent to sacrifice to the Sea God and repair dikes and embankments.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month, on jiwei, a tidal surge in Zhejiang drowned homes and salt pans; Vice Minister of Works Li Yong was sent to offer sacrifice to the Sea God and repair the dikes.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，王恕為刑部侍郎，總理河道。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day yihai, Wang Shu was made Vice Minister of Justice and given overall charge of the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yihai, Wang Shu was made vice minister of justice and put in overall charge of the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，立皇子祐極為皇太子，大赦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jiayin, the Prince Youji was established as Crown Prince; a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiayin, Prince Youji was named crown prince and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 己未，荊、襄賊平，流民復業者一百四十餘萬人。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the bandits in Jing and Xiang were pacified; more than 1,400,000 displaced persons returned to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the Jing-Xiang rebels were pacified; more than 1.4 million refugees returned to their fields.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，彗星見，下詔自責，敕臣修省，條時政得失。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiaxu, a comet appeared; an edict of self-reproach was issued and officials were ordered to practice self-examination and set forth the gains and losses of current policy.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, a comet appeared; the Emperor issued a self-reproach edict, ordered officials to examine their conduct, and called for a review of current policy.

sentences.zh: 壬午，彗星入紫微垣，避正殿，撤樂，御奉天門聽政。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the comet entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure; the Emperor avoided the main hall, suspended music, and held court at Fengtian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the comet entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure; the Emperor left the main hall, halted court music, and heard affairs at Fengtian Gate.

sentences.zh: 癸未，召朱永還，王越總督延綏軍務。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Zhu Yong was recalled; Wang Yue was made overall director of military affairs in Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Zhu Yong was recalled and Wang Yue was put in overall command on the Yan-sui front.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，減死罪以下。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, sentences below capital punishment were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao sentences short of capital punishment were commuted.

sentences.zh: 是年，癿加思蘭入居河套，與阿羅出合。

translations.literal: That year, Qojasan moved into the Ordos bend and joined Aluochu.
translations.idiomatic: That year Qojasan settled in the Ordos bend and joined Aluochu.

sentences.zh: 安南黎灝攻占城，破之。

translations.literal: Li Hao of Annam attacked and took Champa and destroyed it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hao of Annam invaded Champa, took it, and destroyed the kingdom.

sentences.zh: 琉球、安南入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Embassies came from Ryukyu and Annam.

sentences.zh: 成化八年

translations.literal: Chenghua year eight.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，京師久旱，運河水涸。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, the capital suffered prolonged drought and the Grand Canal ran dry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer a long drought gripped the capital and the Grand Canal dried up.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，遣使禱於郊社、山川、淮瀆、東海之神。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, envoys were dispatched to pray at the suburban altars, the community altars, mountains and rivers, the Huai River, and the god of the Eastern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou envoys were sent to pray at the suburban altars, the community altars, mountains and rivers, the Huai, and the Eastern Sea.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，錄囚。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，遣使錄天下囚。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, envoys were dispatched to review prisoners throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai envoys were sent to review prisoners empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，武靖侯趙輔為平虜將軍，充總兵官，節制各邊軍馬，同王越禦癿加思蘭。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day guichou, Zhao Fu, Marquis of Wujing, was made General for the Pacification of the Barbarians and served as supreme commander, directing the armies of the various frontiers, and together with Wang Yue resisted Qojasan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guichou, Zhao Fu, Marquis of Wujing, was made pacification general and supreme commander over the frontier armies, and with Wang Yue met Qojasan in the field.

sentences.zh: 秋九月丙午，諭安南黎灝還占城侵地。

translations.literal: In autumn, ninth month, on the day bingwu, Li Hao of Annam was instructed to return the territory seized from Champa.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on bingwu, Li Hao of Annam was ordered to restore the lands he had taken from Champa.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己酉，寧晉伯劉聚代趙輔為將軍，屯延綏。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on the day jiyou, Liu Ju, Baron of Ningjin, replaced Zhao Fu as general and garrisoned Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiyou, Liu Ju, Baron of Ningjin, replaced Zhao Fu as general and took post at Yan-sui.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，振京師饑民。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day guiyou, famine victims in the capital were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guiyou, famine relief was distributed in the capital.

sentences.zh: 是年，孛羅忽、癿加思蘭屢入安邊營、花馬池，犯固原、寧夏、平涼、臨鞏、環慶，南至通渭。

translations.literal: That year, Boluohu and Qojasan repeatedly entered Anbian Camp and Huamachi, raiding Guyuan, Ningxia, Pingliang, Linqiong, and Huanqing, and reaching as far south as Tongwei.
translations.idiomatic: That year Boluohu and Qojasan repeatedly struck Anbian Camp and Huamachi, raiding Guyuan, Ningxia, Pingliang, Linqiong, and Huanqing as far south as Tongwei.

sentences.zh: 琉球、哈密、安南入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu, Hami, and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Embassies came from Ryukyu, Hami, and Annam.

sentences.zh: 成化九年

translations.literal: Chenghua year nine.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月丁未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on the day dingwei, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, in the first month of spring, on dingwei, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 壬子，劉聚、王越敗癿加思蘭於漫天嶺。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Liu Ju and Wang Yue defeated Qojasan at Mantian Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Liu Ju and Wang Yue routed Qojasan at Mantian Ridge.

sentences.zh: 是月，土魯番速檀阿力破哈密，據之。

translations.literal: That month, Sultan Ali of Turfan took Hami and occupied it.
translations.idiomatic: That month Sultan Ali of Turfan seized Hami and held it.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the new moon day xinyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon xinyou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 甲子，福餘三寇遼東，總兵官歐信擊敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the three tribes of Fuyu raided Liaodong; Supreme Commander Ou Xin defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the three Fuyu tribes raided Liaodong; Supreme Commander Ou Xin beat them back.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，盡免山東稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, all tax grain in Shandong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen all tax grain in Shandong was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 瘞京畿暴骸。

translations.literal: Exposed corpses in the metropolitan region were buried.
translations.idiomatic: Unburied dead around the capital were interred.

sentences.zh: 壬午，閱武臣騎射於西苑。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, military officers were reviewed in mounted archery at the Western Park.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu military officers were reviewed in mounted archery at the Western Park.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，巡撫延綏都御史余子俊敗癿加思蘭於榆林澗。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day renchen, Yu Zijun, regional commander and grand coordinator in Yan-sui, defeated Qojasan at Yulin Stream.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, Yu Zijun, Yan-sui grand coordinator and regional commander, defeated Qojasan at Yulin Stream.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，鎮守浙江中官李義杖殺寧波指揮馬璋，詔勿問。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinmao, Li Yi, the eunuch superintendent in Zhejiang, beat to death Ma Zhang, commander of the Ningbo Guard; an edict ordered that the matter not be pursued.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinmao, Li Yi, the palace eunuch superintendent in Zhejiang, clubbed Ma Zhang, commander of the Ningbo Guard, to death; the court ordered the case dropped.

sentences.zh: 庚子，王越襲滿都魯、孛羅忽、癿加思蘭於紅鹽池，大破之。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Wang Yue raided Mandulu, Boluohu, and Qojasan at Red Salt Pool and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Wang Yue surprised Mandulu, Boluohu, and Qojasan at Red Salt Pool and crushed them.

sentences.zh: 諸部漸出河套。

translations.literal: The various tribes gradually withdrew from the Ordos bend.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol bands gradually withdrew from the Ordos bend.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丁酉，復閱騎射於西苑。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on the day dingyou, mounted archery was again reviewed at the Western Park.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on dingyou, mounted archery was reviewed again at the Western Park.

sentences.zh: 是年，免湖廣、畿內、山西、南畿、陝西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That year, tax grain in disaster-stricken Huguang, the metropolitan region, Shanxi, the Southern Metropolitan Region, and Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year tax grain was forgiven in disaster districts of Huguang, the capital region, Shanxi, the Southern Metropolitan Region, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 振畿內、陝西饑，振山西者再，山東者三。

translations.literal: Famine in the metropolitan region and Shaanxi was relieved; Shanxi was relieved twice and Shandong three times.
translations.idiomatic: Famine relief went to the capital region and Shaanxi; Shanxi was relieved twice and Shandong three times.

sentences.zh: 哈密、琉球、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Hami, Ryukyu, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Embassies came from Hami, Ryukyu, and Siam.

sentences.zh: 成化十年

translations.literal: Chenghua year ten.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月丁亥朔，振京師貧民。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on the new moon day dinghai, relief was extended to the poor of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, in the first month of spring, on the new moon dinghai, the court gave relief to the capital's poor.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，王越總制延綏、甘肅、寧夏三邊，駐固原。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Wang Yue took overall command of the Yan-Sui, Gansu, and Ningxia border sectors and encamped at Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Wang Yue took overall command of the Yan-Sui, Gansu, and Ningxia frontiers and made his headquarters at Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，召劉聚還。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Liu Ju was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Liu Ju was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 三月，免南畿、湖廣被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the third month, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region and Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month autumn grain tax was forgiven in disaster districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊申，申藏妖書之禁。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, on the day wushen, the ban on heterodox prophetic texts was reasserted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on wushen, the throne again enforced the ban on heterodox prophetic texts.

sentences.zh: 是月，免山西、陝西被災秋糧。

translations.literal: That month, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Shanxi and Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster-stricken Shanxi and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 閏六月乙巳，築邊牆自紫城砦至花馬池。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month, on the day yisi, the border wall was built from Zicheng Stockade to Huamachi.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, on yisi, work began on the border wall from Zicheng Stockade to Huamachi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，免江西被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day jiayin, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Jiangxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiayin, autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster-hit Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，都督同知趙勝為平虜將軍，充總兵官，太監劉恆、覃平監軍，討癿加思蘭。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinmao, Vice Commissioner-in-chief Zhao Sheng was made Pacifying Barbarians General, filling the post of supreme commander; Eunuchs Liu Heng and Tan Ping supervised the army in a campaign against Qiyasan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao, Zhao Sheng, vice commissioner-in-chief, was made Pacifying Barbarians General and supreme commander; the eunuchs Liu Heng and Tan Ping oversaw the army in a campaign against Qiyasan.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the new moon day guichou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon guichou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，免南畿水災秋糧。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, autumn grain tax in the Southern Metropolitan Region stricken by flood was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao autumn grain tax was forgiven in the flood-stricken Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丙子，免河南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on the day bingzi, tax grain in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on bingzi, tax grain was remitted in disaster-stricken Henan.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，罷寶慶諸府採金。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jichou, gold mining in Baqing and other prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jichou, the court ended gold mining in Baqing and neighboring prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲午，錄妖書名示天下。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the titles of heterodox prophetic texts were recorded and displayed to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the court published a register of banned heterodox texts for the whole empire.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、烏斯藏、土魯番入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Ü-Tsang, and Turfan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu, Ü-Tsang, and Turfan sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 成化十一年

translations.literal: Chenghua year eleven.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月癸亥，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, spring, first month, on the day guihai, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, in the first month of spring, on guihai, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，禁酷刑。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiashen, cruel punishments were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiashen, cruel punishments were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，賜謝遷等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renzi, Xie Qian and others were granted jinshi with distinctions of first rank, origin, and so forth.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renzi, Xie Qian and others received jinshi degrees with distinctions of rank and origin.

sentences.zh: 辛未，彭時卒。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Peng Shi died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Peng Shi died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，吏部侍郎劉珝、禮部侍郎劉吉並兼翰林學士，入閣預機務。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day yiyou, Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Xu and Vice Minister of Rites Liu Ji were concurrently made Hanlin academicians and entered the Grand Secretariat to participate in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou, Liu Xu, vice minister of personnel, and Liu Ji, vice minister of rites, were also made Hanlin academicians and joined the Grand Secretariat to deliberate state secrets.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，乾清門災。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Qianqing Gate was destroyed by fire.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen fire destroyed Qianqing Gate.

sentences.zh: 己亥，錄囚。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，免湖廣被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day guiyou, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiyou, autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster-stricken Huguang.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛巳，浚通惠河。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, on the day xinsi, the Tonghui Canal was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on xinsi, the Tonghui Canal was dredged.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，滿都魯、癿加思蘭遣使來朝。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Mandulu and Qiyasan sent envoys to court.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Mandulu and Qiyasan sent envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the new moon day dingwei, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon dingwei, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸丑，立皇子祐樘為皇太子，大赦。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on the day guichou, the imperial son Youcheng was installed as crown prince and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on guichou, the imperial son Zhu Youcheng was installed as crown prince and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，復郕王帝號。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wuzi, the imperial title of the Prince of Cheng was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuzi, the Prince of Cheng was again accorded an emperor's title.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，申自宮之禁。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the ban on voluntary castration was reasserted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the throne again enforced the ban on voluntary castration.

sentences.zh: 是年，土魯番、琉球、暹羅、滿剌加、安南入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Turfan, Ryukyu, Siam, Malacca, and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Turfan, Ryukyu, Siam, Malacca, and Annam sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 命琉球貢使二年一至。

translations.literal: It was ordered that Ryukyu tribute envoys should come once every two years.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Ryukyu's tribute missions to arrive once every two years.

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation notes

sentences.zh: [一] 進永爵為侯 此繫於成化二年十月丁未，本書卷一七三朱謙傳附朱永傳繫於成化元年秋，又卷一○七功臣世表繫於成化三年正月壬申，憲宗實錄卷三八同。

translations.literal: [1] Advance Yong to marquis — here dated to dingwei of the tenth month in Chenghua year 2; this book, juan 173, Biography of Zhu Qian with appended Biography of Zhu Yong, places it in autumn of Chenghua year 1; again, juan 107, Chronological Table of Meritorious Officials, places it in renshen of the first month of Chenghua year 3; the Xianzong Shilu, juan 38, agrees.
translations.idiomatic: [1] "Advance Yong to marquis": here dated to dingwei of the tenth month in Chenghua 2; this book, juan 173, Biography of Zhu Qian with appended Biography of Zhu Yong, places it in autumn of Chenghua 1; juan 107, Chronological Table of Meritorious Officials, places it in renshen of the first month of Chenghua 3; the Xianzong Shilu, juan 38, agrees.

sentences.zh: 似以作三年正月較可信。

translations.literal: It seems more credible to place it in the first month of the third year.
translations.idiomatic: Placing the event in the first month of the third year seems the more credible reading.

sentences.zh: [二] 築邊牆自紫城砦至花馬池 紫城砦，憲宗實錄卷一三○作「紫垣砦」，國榷卷三七頁二三四三作「紫金砦」。

translations.literal: [2] Build the border wall from Zicheng Stockade to Huamachi — for Zicheng Stockade, the Xianzong Shilu, juan 130, reads "Ziyuan Stockade"; Guoque, juan 37, p. 2343, reads "Zijin Stockade."
translations.idiomatic: [2] "Build the border wall from Zicheng Stockade to Huamachi": for Zicheng Stockade, the Xianzong Shilu, juan 130, reads "Ziyuan Stockade"; Guoque, juan 37, p. 2343, reads "Zijin Stockade."
